summary.intent: Remove the design:sync skill from the cipher-box project since the user is no longer actively using Pencil.
summary.outcome: The design:sync skill directory was deleted, CLAUDE.md was updated to remove references to it, and the changes were committed and pushed to a PR branch.

repo: cipher-box project has a skills system with individual skill directories, referenced from CLAUDE.md
Skills can be cleanly removed by deleting their directory and updating CLAUDE.md

code.finding: Contains references to available skills including design:sync, which needed to be removed

workflow: Skill removal involves two steps: deleting the skill directory and updating CLAUDE.md references
Changes were pushed directly to a PR branch rather than main

open_items: User is not actively using Pencil right now — design:sync skill may need to be re-added if Pencil usage resumes
